newsitem.title: USA: Flores to talk to credit rating agencies.
newsitem.headline: Flores to talk to credit rating agencies.

text.p: Independent U.S. oil exploration and production company Flores & Rucks Inc is plans to discuss its credit rating with agencies.
"We are looking forward to visiting the rating agencies to have a discussion on the rating of our bonds," company chairman James Flores told a conference call.
The company's senior unsecured notes are rated single B plus by Standard & Poor's.

Flores told the conference call, which followed the company's fourth quarter earnings, that he expected the company to produce 35,000 barrels of oil equivalent (boe) per day in the first quarter of 1997, in line with analysts' expectations. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
